# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 079

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1950–1974, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I corrected `drop`, whose previous Hindi example said that the phone fell by itself instead of expressing that the speaker caused it to fall. The other 24 entries were semantically accurate and suitable for learners.

Changed: 1 Hindi gloss/example pair; 25 senses reviewed.

Progress: 1,975/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (22.34%); 6,862 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
